title: Warmer Without Recreating The Scene
tests: Tests whether a terse warmth tweak applies a colour adjustment to the existing image without regenerating or charging for the scene twice.

faults.what: Both book pages contain visible printed text, contrary to the explicit request for no text.
The mug rests on the open book rather than beside it.

judge.summary: The square image has attractive warm lighting, but the book contains unwanted text and the missing original prevents verification of a colour-only edit.

must_haves.item: The final image has a visibly warmer colour balance than the first output.
must_haves.why: The supplied image looks warm, but no first output is provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: The same blue ceramic mug, open book and wooden windowsill remain in exactly the same positions.
must_haves.why: All three objects are visible, but their original positions cannot be checked without the first output.

must_haves.item: Framing, object shapes, book details and background details are unchanged from the first output.
must_haves.why: Only the edited image is supplied, so preservation of these details cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The image is square and contains no text.
must_haves.why: The image is square, but visible lines of printed text cover both book pages.
